message_ja: v0.3.61 は重要な修正です。SDR で SSTV（ISS の画像など）を受信しても FM 復調されず画像が出なかった問題を修正しました。あわせて SSTV タブに「画像を開く」、Quick Comms の ISS (V)/(U) 分割、FT4 送信音声の改善を含みます。
message_en: Version 0.3.61 is a critical fix: SDR reception of SSTV (e.g. ISS images) was demodulated as USB instead of FM, so no image appeared. It also adds Open Image in the SSTV tab, ISS (V)/(U) in Quick Comms, and FT4 TX audio improvements.
_comment: Bump latest_version on every release. Raise minimum_supported_version and set critical=true only when older versions genuinely misbehave and every user must update; otherwise keep critical=false. See docs/app-update.md.
